title: MICP Reproducibility & Versioning — Input Contract
description: Strict input contract for the micp-reproducibility-versioning skill (MRV). Every required field is mandatory; missing required fields MUST be reported with explicit field names, why they are critical, and how to obtain them (never a generic '信息不足'). Version 1.0.0. Breaking changes require a major version bump.

task_id.description: Task node identifier. Required: audit anchor and provenance event key.

project_id.description: Project/experiment identifier. Required: selects provenance, manifest and lockfile names.

request.description: The natural-language governance request (must state a deliverable).

skill_version.description: Version of THIS skill (micp-reproducibility-versioning). Required: version compatibility gate.

controller_version.description: Version of the calling Obsidian Controller (e.g. obsidian-ctl-0.1.0). Required: permission model version gate.

action.description: Explicit governance action. When omitted, the service infers it from the request text; inference failure is MRV-E106.

root.description: Project root to govern. Optional; defaults to the current working directory. When provided, it must exist (MRV-E104).

targets.description: Paths to govern (files or directories, relative to root). Optional.

commands.description: Execution steps for action=reproduce: {id, cmd, cwd, expected_outputs}. Required for reproduce.

cmd.description: Shell command to execute. Deterministic by construction (no wall-clock or RNG); if the command is not deterministic the manifest records a risk.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to root. Default: root.

expected_outputs.description: Output paths (relative to root) this step is expected to produce; hashed after the run.

parameters.description: Experiment parameters recorded in the reproduction manifest (folded into the parameter fingerprint).

schema_versions.description: Schema/artifact versions to check (compat) or migrate (migrate), e.g. { 'manifest': '2.0.0', 'provenance': '1.0.0' }.

seed_policy.description: generate: mint a new seed. reuse: reuse the provided random_seed (default). require: reuse AND record as required (fails if absent).

random_seed.description: Seed to reuse. Default 0. Deterministic RNG in this skill uses splitmix64/PCG so the same seed produces byte-identical runs.

previous_manifest.description: Path (relative to root) of a previous reproduction-manifest to diff against (action=diff).

previous_provenance.description: Path (relative to root) of a previous provenance log to diff against (action=diff).

context.description: Execution context: task graph, memory refs, call chain, environment snapshot.

fail_on_dirty.description: When true, reproduction fails if the working tree is dirty (unregistered modifications). Default false.

ignore_raw_write_protection.description: When true and the raw write-protection check fails, degrade to PARTIAL instead of BLOCKED. Default false.

record_inputs.description: Hash and record the input fileset in the manifest. Default true.

record_outputs.description: Hash and record the output fileset in the manifest. Default true.

write_output_dir.description: Where to persist manifests/provenance (relative to root). Default: provenance/.

reproducibility.description: Seed material for deterministic re-runs. This skill's own RNG is splitmix64+PCG.

requested_output_format.description: 'json' = output.schema.json document only; 'markdown+json' = human summary plus the JSON document.

human_approval_state.description: When risk_level is high/critical and a real experiment, field deployment, hazardous-chemical handling, or long-term knowledge write is involved, approved is required before SUCCESS.
